proof.text: On each affine open, coherence implies quasi-coherence. The defining transition factors as an ideal-power quotient projection followed by an isomorphism. Quasi-coherent affine cokernel sections make each transition surjective; quasi-coherence of its source ideal product follows from tensor and image closure. Mathlib Concrete.surjective_π_app_zero_of_surjective_map, applied to the initial shifted diagram m ↦ n+m, makes the canonical limit projection onto every level surjective. This is implemented by the proved private lemmas projection_surjective, product_qc and formal_projection_surjective.

For b in K(U)^t and y in G_n(U), lift y to z in the inverse limit. The cokernel hypothesis says bz is in the range of the limit map, say bz=alpha_U(x). Naturality of limit projections gives by=alpha_n(U)(projection_n(x)). The level cokernel projection therefore kills by. Its affine surjectivity proves b annihilates every section of the level cokernel. No kernel-annihilation hypothesis or reduction-modulo-an-ideal theorem is needed. For the unchanged conclusion use K(U)^(2t) ≤ K(U)^t.

Affine ideal-power sections identify the scalar of each section of K^(2t) with an element of K(U)^(2t). The affine tensor-sections map is surjective, and on elementary tensors the multiplication morphism sends j tensor s to j*s. Tensor induction therefore shows the multiplication morphism vanishes on affine sections of every cover member. This is the first part of the proved private lemma product_zero_on_affine_cover.

The source of the multiplication morphism is quasi-coherent. On each affine cover member, restrict and apply the already proved source-library Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_isAffine to deduce vanishing of the restricted morphism. Scheme.Modules.hom_eq_zero_of_restrict glues this to global vanishing, including the empty cover on the empty scheme. Cancel factorThruImage and use IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero on image.ι: the image defining the ideal-module product is zero. This completes the proved private lemma product_zero_on_affine_cover.

theorem coherentFormalModule_annihilated_double_cokernel (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ G)
    (r : ℕ) (U : Fin r → X.affineOpens) (t : ℕ)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, (U i).1) = ⊤) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin r,
      K.ideal (U i) ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, (U i).1) (LinearMap.ker
        (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U i).1)))).hom) ∧
      K.ideal (U i) ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, (U i).1)
        (↥(limit (G.obj ⋙
          SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U i).1)) :
          ModuleCat Γ(X, (U i).1)) ⧸ LinearMap.range
          (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U i).1)))).hom)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (2 * t)).2
        (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n))))
